knowledge_policy: Historical teaching reconstruction, not an archived intelligence snapshot. Decisions use advisory facts available by scenario_as_of. CVSS labels are normalized from sources consulted during authoring; exact historical score publication timestamps are not reconstructed.
control_evidence_age_policy: Use scenario-local dates. Age 7 remains in range; age 8 requires review. Freshness never proves test coverage or effectiveness.
deadline_policy: Date-only deadlines mean scenario-local end of day. A's 2022-06-16 SLA is a synthetic internal target, not a CISA deadline or approved acceptance. B's 2022-06-03 is the mitigation target, not its patch deadline.
missing_values: Blank means unknown or unset, never zero, false, approved or unlimited validity. NOT_APPLICABLE denotes an inapplicable acceptance workflow; legacy n/a text is retained where present.
asset_reachability_policy: prod_reachability is an enum: true, false, conditional, unknown. It describes the source asset's outbound relationship in the scoped model, not whether PROD can receive any traffic. Never cast it as a boolean.
evidence_policy: Inventory, ACL tests, proxy logs, EDR review, ownership, SLA and risk acceptance reference are fictional inputs. No actual logs or signed approvals are included.
patch_policy: 7.13.7 and 74.0.1 are historical fixes for specific CVEs on named branches, not recommended current deployment versions. Numeric >= is not a cross-branch applicability check.
artifact_status: Reviewable article and static synthetic fixtures; no risk engine, live network test, approval, patch or publication has been executed.
